elements.text:
Your crush hasn't responded in a few days. After long deliberation, you send a double text. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: I feel like I broke an unspoken rule, but these rules are made up anyway.
This will show my crush I'm interested.
People double text all the time.
I'm worried my crush will find my annoying, but remind myself that if they like me one extra text won't bother them.
